description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for handling message processing, condition checking, schema conversion, and message history management within a language model or agent framework, specifically tailored for integration with langchain and related components.

classes.name: ExtractTool
classes.description: A structured tool class for extracting structured data from output, extending the StructuredTool base class.

classes.name: RunnableCallable
classes.description: A class extending Runnable to wrap a function with additional configuration, tracing, and recursion capabilities.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates a condition between input and a value, supporting string and numeric comparisons.

methods.name: transformObjectPropertyToFunction
methods.description: Transforms object properties into functions, resolving message content and state references.

methods.name: processImageMessage
methods.description: Processes image messages with vision support, adjusting the model accordingly.

methods.name: customGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an object based on a complex path, supporting negative indices.

methods.name: convertStructuredSchemaToZod
methods.description: Converts a schema (string or object) into a Zod validation object.

methods.name: filterConversationHistory
methods.description: Filters conversation history based on the selected option (e.g., last message, user question).

methods.name: restructureMessages
methods.description: Reformats messages for compatibility with different LLMs, handling tool calls and message order.

methods.name: checkMessageHistory
methods.description: Evaluates and potentially modifies message history based on JavaScript code execution.
